examples.title: Print a labeled count
examples.explanation: fmt checks a literal format string against its arguments at compile time when supported.

guides.definition: Builds an std::string with fmt::format without writing to an output stream. Project dependency only: link fmt or configure its header-only mode in a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

parameters.name: formatString
parameters.description: C++ string literal containing replacement fields.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value inserted into the replacement field.

examples.title: Create a status message
examples.explanation: fmt::format returns the completed string and preserves the type-aware formatting rules used by fmt::print.

guides.definition: Formats every item in a range with a separator using fmt::join. Project dependency only: link fmt or configure its header-only mode in a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Comma-separated integer expressions for the vector.

examples.title: Print comma-separated values
examples.explanation: fmt::join presents a range lazily to the formatter, avoiding a manual loop solely for display.
